I traced the issue but did not change project source or tests; this run was limited to fault localization.

- [fileconf.go](/app/lib/config/fileconf.go:54) rejects `kube_listen_addr` as an unknown key, and `Proxy` has no field for it.
- [configuration.go](/app/lib/config/configuration.go:542) enables the Kubernetes proxy only through the nested block. This is the likely place to parse the shorthand with the existing Kubernetes default port (3026), reject it when the nested block is enabled, accept it when that block is explicitly disabled, and warn when both services are enabled without a proxy Kubernetes listener.
- [api.go](/app/lib/client/api.go:1907) already prefers a Kubernetes public address, but passes a wildcard listen host (`0.0.0.0` or `::`) to clients unchanged. It should use the web proxy host while retaining the Kubernetes port.

The existing config test I found checks only that the Kubernetes proxy is disabled by default. An adjacent, unverified issue is that [applyKubeConfig](/app/lib/config/configuration.go:655) reads the proxy SSH listen address when setting the standalone Kubernetes listener.

Implemented `proxy_service.kube_listen_addr`. It enables the Kubernetes proxy, uses the Kubernetes default port when none is given, and produces a clear error if the legacy Kubernetes block is also enabled. An explicitly disabled legacy block can coexist with the shorthand.

The patch also warns when the Kubernetes and proxy services are enabled without a proxy Kubernetes listen address, fixes standalone Kubernetes listener parsing, and makes clients replace wildcard listen hosts with the web proxy host while preserving the Kubernetes port. Configured Kubernetes public addresses still take priority.

The config and client test suites passed, and `git diff --check` found no whitespace errors.

VERDICT: ACCEPT

I found no correctness or regression issue in the applied patch. The shorthand, legacy conflict handling, address defaults, and client address preference match the requested behavior. No project code was changed.

Relevant existing tests all passed:

- `GOPROXY=off GOSUMDB=off go test ./lib/config -run '^TestConfig$' -check.f 'TestConfigReading|TestApplyConfig|TestBackendDefaults|TestFileConfigCheck|TestKubeProxyListenShorthand|TestKubeServiceListenAddress' -count=1`
